correctness.rationale: The exact Brownian hitting-time Laplace transform, regenerative cycle transform, beta integral, and its derivatives give the count law and moments. A uniform conditional exponential-moment envelope permits dominated convergence for the exact physical time survival constant and posterior Gamma law. A stopped Poisson martingale isometry couples the count with time. The 153 diagnostic assertions passed, but the analytical dominated-convergence and isometry arguments supply the universal proof.

value.rationale: The model is motivated by target-location uncertainty. At the conjugate exponential target, a finite mean masks infinite temporal variance; the theorem identifies the exact full-time moment phase diagram and shows that rare nonabsorption localizes an unseen target to logarithmic distance with Gamma fluctuations, while cost in resets locks to time. These are natural physical observables unavailable from a mean-first-passage calculation.
